title: विंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 120 · On the king's policy and the realm's protection

summary.en: Yudhishthira says that many rules of kingship have been told, and asks about protecting his people and the means of it. Bhishma speaks of keeping counsel, watching his own side and the enemy, and acting with deep and unrevealed purpose.
summary.kn: ರಾಜನೀತಿಯ ಅನೇಕ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ, ಪ್ರಜೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಲಹೆ ಗೌಪ್ಯವಾಗಿಡುವುದು, ತನ್ನ ಪಕ್ಷ, ಶತ್ರುವನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸುವುದು, ಆಳವಾದ, ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸದ ಉದ್ದೇಶದಿಂದ ವರ್ತಿಸುವ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर कहते हैं कि राजनीति के अनेक नियम कहे गए हैं और प्रजा-रक्षा तथा उसके साधनों के बारे में पूछते हैं। भीष्म मन्त्रणा गुप्त रखने, अपने पक्ष और शत्रु पर दृष्टि रखने और गहन अप्रकट उद्देश्य से कार्य करने की बात कहते हैं।
summary.te: రాజనీతి నియమాలు ఎన్నో చెప్పబడ్డాయని, ప్రజారక్షణ, దాని సాధనాల గురించి చెప్పమని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. సలహా రహస్యంగా ఉంచడం, తన పక్షాన్ని, శత్రువును గమనించడం, లోతైన బయటపడని ఉద్దేశంతో నడుచుకోవడం గురించి భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: ராஜநீதியின் பல விதிகள் கூறப்பட்டுவிட்டன, குடிகளைக் காப்பதையும் அதன் வழிகளையும் கூறும்படி யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்கிறார். ஆலோசனையை இரகசியமாக வைத்தல், தன் பக்கத்தையும் பகைவரையும் கவனித்தல், ஆழ்ந்த வெளிப்படுத்தாத நோக்குடன் செயல்படுதல் பற்றிப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: രാജത്വത്തിന്റെ പല നിയമങ്ങളും പറഞ്ഞുകഴിഞ്ഞുവെന്നും, ജനങ്ങളെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും അതിനുള്ള മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും പറയണമെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പറയുന്നു. രഹസ്യം സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനെയും സ്വന്തം പക്ഷത്തെയും ശത്രുവിനെയും നിരീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനെയും, ആഴമേറിയതും വെളിപ്പെടുത്താത്തതുമായ ലക്ഷ്യത്തോടെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നതിനെയും കുറിച്ച് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.120; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
राजवृत्तान्यनेकानि त्वया प्रोक्तानि भारत ।
पूर्वैः पूर्वनियुक्तानि राजधर्मार्थवेदिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, you have described many kinds of royal conduct, laid down long ago by earlier sages who knew the king's duty and its aims.

verses.text:
तदेव विस्तरेणोक्तं पूर्वैर्दृष्टं सतां मतम् ।
प्रणयं राजधर्माणां प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Bull of the Bharatas, tell me now in full the very conduct seen by the ancients and approved by the good, the guiding principles of a king's duties.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
रक्षणं सर्वभूतानामिति क्षत्रे परं मतम् ।
तद्यथा रक्षणं कुर्यात्तथा शृणु महीपते ॥

meaning.en: Protecting all beings is held to be the highest duty of a warrior. Listen, lord of the earth, to how one should go about protecting them.

verses.text:
यथा बर्हाणि चित्राणि बिभर्ति भुजगाशनः ।
तथा बहुविधं राजा रूपं कुर्वीत धर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: As the peacock, eater of snakes, bears many colored plumes, so a king who knows dharma should take on many forms.

verses.text:
तैक्ष्ण्यं जिह्मत्वमादान्त्यं सत्यमार्जवमेव च ।
मध्यस्थः सत्त्वमातिष्ठंस्तथा वै सुखमृच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Sharpness, crookedness, restraint, truth and honesty: keeping to the middle and holding to goodness, he finds happiness.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्नर्थे हितं यत्स्यात्तद्वर्णं रूपमाविशेत् ।
बहुरूपस्य राज्ञो हि सूक्ष्मोऽप्यर्थो न सीदति ॥

meaning.en: In whatever matter benefit lies, he should take on the color and form suited to it; a king of many forms never lets even a subtle aim fail.

verses.text:
नित्यं रक्षितमन्त्रः स्याद्यथा मूकः शरच्छिखी ।
श्लक्ष्णाक्षरतनुः श्रीमान्भवेच्छास्त्रविशारदः ॥

meaning.en: He should always guard his counsel, silent like the peacock; soft in speech, slender in word, prosperous, and skilled in the scriptures.

verses.text:
आपद्द्वारेषु यत्तः स्याज्जलप्रस्रवणेष्विव ।
शैलवर्षोदकानीव द्विजान्सिद्धान्समाश्रयेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should be watchful at the gates of danger, as at channels where water pours out; against calamities like torrents from the mountains he should take refuge in brahmins and perfected sages.

verses.text:
अर्थकामः शिखां राजा कुर्याद्धर्मध्वजोपमाम् ।
नित्यमुद्यतदण्डः स्यादाचरेच्चाप्रमादतः ।
लोके चायव्ययौ दृष्ट्वा वृक्षाद्वृक्षमिवाप्लवन् ॥

meaning.en: A king desiring wealth should wear a crest like the banner of dharma, always keep the rod raised, and act without negligence, observing income and expense in the world and leaping like a bird from tree to tree.

verses.text:
मृजावान्स्यात्स्वयूथ्येषु भावानि चरणैः क्षिपेत् ।
जातपक्षः परिस्पन्देद्रक्षेद्वैकल्यमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: He should be gentle among his own kind and, like the bird, strike down hostile things with his feet; once his wings have grown, he should move about and guard against any flaw in himself.

verses.text:
दोषान्विवृणुयाच्छत्रोः परपक्षान्विधूनयेत् ।
काननेष्विव पुष्पाणि बर्हीवार्थान्समाचरेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should expose the enemy's faults and shake off the enemy's side; he should pursue his aims as the peacock moves among forest flowers.

verses.text:
उच्छ्रितानाश्रयेत्स्फीतान्नरेन्द्रानचलोपमान् ।
श्रयेच्छायामविज्ञातां गुप्तं शरणमाश्रयेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should rely on prosperous, mountain-like kings of high standing, and take shelter in unknown shade, a hidden refuge.

verses.text:
प्रावृषीवासितग्रीवो मज्जेत निशि निर्जने ।
मायूरेण गुणेनैव स्त्रीभिश्चालक्षितश्चरेत् ।
न जह्याच्च तनुत्राणं रक्षेदात्मानमात्मना ॥

meaning.en: As the dark-necked peacock dances in the rains, so he should plunge into solitude at night; with a peacock's quality he should move unnoticed even by women, never give up his armor, and guard himself by himself.

verses.text:
चारभूमिष्वभिगमान्पाशांश्च परिवर्जयेत् ।
पीडयेच्चापि तां भूमिं प्रणश्येद्गहने पुनः ॥

meaning.en: He should avoid frequented grounds and snares, trouble such ground, and then vanish again in thick cover.

verses.text:
हन्यात्क्रुद्धानतिविषान्ये जिह्मगतयोऽहितान् ।
नाश्रयेद्बालबर्हाणि सन्निवासानि वासयेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should kill angry, extremely venomous enemies who go by crooked ways; he should not rely on the plumes of the young, nor let dwellings be settled carelessly.

verses.text:
सदा बर्हिनिभः कामं प्रसक्तिकृतमाचरेत् ।
सर्वतश्चाददेत्प्रज्ञां पतंगान्गहनेष्विव ।
एवं मयूरवद्राजा स्वराष्ट्रं परिपालयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Like the peacock he should always indulge desire only as far as attachment allows, and gather wisdom from everywhere as the bird snaps up insects in thickets; thus like a peacock a king should protect his own kingdom.

verses.text:
आत्मवृद्धिकरीं नीतिं विदधीत विचक्षणः ।
आत्मसंयमनं बुद्ध्या परबुद्ध्यावतारणम् ।
बुद्ध्या चात्मगुणप्राप्तिरेतच्छास्त्रनिदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: The discerning king should adopt a policy that increases his own strength: self-restraint through intellect, drawing out the minds of others, and gaining one's own virtues through understanding. This is what the scripture shows.

verses.text:
परं चाश्वासयेत्साम्ना स्वशक्तिं चोपलक्षयेत् ।
आत्मनः परिमर्शेन बुद्धिं बुद्ध्या विचारयेत् ।
सान्त्वयोगमतिः प्राज्ञः कार्याकार्यविचारकः ॥

meaning.en: He should reassure an enemy with conciliation and take stock of his own strength; examining himself, he should weigh intellect with intellect. The wise man, bent on conciliation, discerns what should and should not be done.

verses.text:
निगूढबुद्धिर्धीरः स्याद्वक्तव्ये वक्ष्यते तथा ।
संनिकृष्टां कथां प्राज्ञो यदि बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतिः ।
स्वभावमेष्यते तप्तं कृष्णायसमिवोदके ॥

meaning.en: He should be steady, keeping his thinking hidden, and speak only what is to be said. Closely wise in discussion, like Brihaspati, he will return to his nature as hot black iron does in water.

verses.text:
अनुयुञ्जीत कृत्यानि सर्वाण्येव महीपतिः ।
आगमैरुपदिष्टानि स्वस्य चैव परस्य च ॥

meaning.en: The king should supervise all tasks, both his own and the enemy's, as taught in the scriptures.

verses.text:
क्षुद्रं क्रूरं तथा प्राज्ञं शूरं चार्थविशारदम् ।
स्वकर्मणि नियुञ्जीत ये चान्ये वचनाधिकाः ॥

meaning.en: He should assign the petty, the cruel, the wise, the brave, the expert in affairs, and others outstanding in speech, to work suited to their own natures.

verses.text:
अप्यदृष्ट्वा नियुक्तानि अनुरूपेषु कर्मसु ।
सर्वांस्ताननुवर्तेत स्वरांस्तन्त्रीरिवायता ॥

meaning.en: Even those appointed unseen to fitting tasks, he should keep following, as the player follows all the notes of a stretched lute-string.

verses.text:
धर्माणामविरोधेन सर्वेषां प्रियमाचरेत् ।
ममायमिति राजा यः स पर्वत इवाचलः ॥

meaning.en: Without conflict with any dharma he should do what is pleasing to all; the king who says 'this is mine' of everything stands firm as a mountain.

verses.text:
व्यवसायं समाधाय सूर्यो रश्मिमिवायताम् ।
धर्ममेवाभिरक्षेत कृत्वा तुल्ये प्रियाप्रिये ॥

meaning.en: Fixing his resolve as the sun fixes its stretched rays, and treating the pleasant and unpleasant alike, he should protect dharma alone.

verses.text:
कुलप्रकृतिदेशानां धर्मज्ञान्मृदुभाषिणः ।
मध्ये वयसि निर्दोषान्हिते युक्ताञ्जितेन्द्रियान् ॥

meaning.en: He should choose for all tasks those who know dharma, speak gently, are of good family, character and country, are in middle age and faultless, devoted to his good and masters of their senses.

verses.text:
अलुब्धाञ्शिक्षितान्दान्तान्धर्मेषु परिनिष्ठितान् ।
स्थापयेत्सर्वकार्येषु राजा धर्मार्थरक्षिणः ॥

meaning.en: They should be free from greed, trained, self-controlled, firm in dharma, and guardians of dharma and wealth; the king should set such men over all his work.

verses.text:
एतेनैव प्रकारेण कृत्यानामागतिं गतिम् ।
युक्तः समनुतिष्ठेत तुष्टश्चारैरुपस्कृतः ॥

meaning.en: In this same way, alert and satisfied, aided by spies, he should oversee the coming and going of all tasks.

verses.text:
अमोघक्रोधहर्षस्य स्वयं कृत्यान्ववेक्षिणः ।
आत्मप्रत्ययकोशस्य वसुधैव वसुंधरा ॥

meaning.en: For the king whose anger and joy are never in vain, who himself watches over affairs, and whose treasury is his own trust, the earth truly bears wealth.

verses.text:
व्यक्तश्चानुग्रहो यस्य यथार्थश्चापि निग्रहः ।
गुप्तात्मा गुप्तराष्ट्रश्च स राजा राजधर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: The king whose favor is plain and whose punishment is just, who guards himself and his realm, knows the king's duty.

verses.text:
नित्यं राष्ट्रमवेक्षेत गोभिः सूर्य इवोत्पतन् ।
चारांश्च नचरान्विद्यात्तथा बुद्ध्या न संज्वरेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should watch the kingdom constantly, like the sun rising with its rays; he should know his spies and not burn with worry.

verses.text:
कालप्राप्तमुपादद्यान्नार्थं राजा प्रसूचयेत् ।
अहन्यहनि संदुह्यान्महीं गामिव बुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: The wise king should take what is due at the right time and not advertise his aims; he should milk the earth day after day like a cow.

verses.text:
यथा क्रमेण पुष्पेभ्यश्चिनोति मधु षट्पदः ।
तथा द्रव्यमुपादाय राजा कुर्वीत संचयम् ॥

meaning.en: As the bee gathers honey from flowers in due order, so the king should take wealth and build up a store.

verses.text:
यद्धि गुप्तावशिष्टं स्यात्तद्धितं धर्मकामयोः ।
संचयानुविसर्गी स्याद्राजा शास्त्रविदात्मवान् ॥

meaning.en: What remains after protection serves both dharma and desire. The king who knows the scriptures and is self-possessed should save and also spend.

verses.text:
नाल्पमर्थं परिभवेन्नावमन्येत शात्रवान् ।
बुद्ध्यावबुध्येदात्मानं न चाबुद्धिषु विश्वसेत् ॥

meaning.en: He should not despise a small gain nor underrate enemies; he should know himself by intellect and not trust the unintelligent.

verses.text:
धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं संयमो बुद्धिरग्र्या
धैर्यं शौर्यं देशकालोऽप्रमादः ।
स्वल्पस्य वा महतो वापि वृद्धौ
धनस्यैतान्यष्ट समिन्धनानि ॥

meaning.en: Steadiness, skill, restraint, supreme intelligence, courage, valor, right place and time, and heedfulness: these eight kindle the growth of wealth, whether small or great.

verses.text:
अग्निस्तोको वर्धते ह्याज्यसिक्तो
बीजं चैकं बहुसाहस्रमेति ।
क्षयोदयौ विपुलौ संनिशाम्य
तस्मादल्पं नावमन्येत विद्वान् ॥

meaning.en: A small fire grows when fed with ghee, and a single seed yields thousands. Seeing great decline and great rise, the wise should therefore not despise the small.

verses.text:
बालोऽबालः स्थविरो वा रिपुर्यः
सदा प्रमत्तं पुरुषं निहन्यात् ।
कालेनान्यस्तस्य मूलं हरेत
कालज्ञाता पार्थिवानां वरिष्ठः ॥

meaning.en: Whether child or grown, old or young, an enemy may strike down a man who is always careless; another, knowing the time, may in due season uproot him: the best of kings knows time.

verses.text:
हरेत्कीर्तिं धर्ममस्योपरुन्ध्या-
दर्थे दीर्घं वीर्यमस्योपहन्यात् ।
रिपुर्द्वेष्टा दुर्बलो वा बली वा
तस्माच्छत्रौ नैव हेडेद्यतात्मा ॥

meaning.en: The enemy, hating, whether weak or strong, may steal his fame, block his dharma, and destroy his long-built strength in his goals; therefore a self-controlled king should never slight an enemy.

verses.text:
क्षयं शत्रोः संचयं पालनं चा-
प्युभौ चार्थौ सहितौ धर्मकामौ ।
अतश्चान्यन्मतिमान्संदधीत
तस्माद्राजा बुद्धिमन्तं श्रयेत ॥

meaning.en: Destroying the enemy, accumulating wealth, and protecting it: these two aims together serve dharma and desire. The wise man arranges other things beyond these, and so a king should rely on a wise man.

verses.text:
बुद्धिर्दीप्ता बलवन्तं हिनस्ति
बलं बुद्ध्या वर्धते पाल्यमानम् ।
शत्रुर्बुद्ध्या सीदते वर्धमानो
बुद्धेः पश्चात्कर्म यत्तत्प्रशस्तम् ॥

meaning.en: Blazing intellect destroys the strong; strength increases when guarded by intellect; a growing enemy is brought low by intellect. Action that follows after thought is praised.

verses.text:
सर्वान्कामान्कामयानो हि धीरः
सत्त्वेनाल्पेनाप्लुते हीनदेहः ।
यथात्मानं प्रार्थयतेऽर्थमानैः
श्रेयःपात्रं पूरयते ह्यनल्पम् ॥

meaning.en: The steady man wanting all his desires, even if frail of body, plunges in with small strength. As he sets himself to his goals, he fills a great vessel of welfare.

verses.text:
तस्माद्राजा प्रगृहीतः परेषु
मूलं लक्ष्म्याः सर्वतोऽभ्याददीत ।
दीर्घं कालमपि संपीड्यमानो
विद्युत्संपातमिव मानोर्जितः स्यात् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore a king, though seized by enemies, should seize the root of prosperity from all sides; though pressed for a long time, he should rise like lightning falling, proud and bright.

verses.text:
विद्या तपो वा विपुलं धनं वा
सर्वमेतद्व्यवसायेन शक्यम् ।
ब्रह्म यत्तं निवसति देहवत्सु
तस्माद्विद्याद्व्यवसायं प्रभूतम् ॥

meaning.en: Learning, austerity or vast wealth: all this is possible through resolve. Brahman dwells in embodied beings, so one should recognize resolve as mighty.

verses.text:
यत्रासते मतिमन्तो मनस्विनः
शक्रो विष्णुर्यत्र सरस्वती च ।
वसन्ति भूतानि च यत्र नित्यं
तस्माद्विद्वान्नावमन्येत देहम् ॥

meaning.en: Where wise and thoughtful men dwell, where Indra, Vishnu and Sarasvati are, and where beings always live: therefore the learned man should not despise the body.

verses.text:
लुब्धं हन्यात्संप्रदानेन नित्यं
लुब्धस्तृप्तिं परवित्तस्य नैति ।
सर्वो लुब्धः कर्मगुणोपभोगे
योऽर्थैर्हीनो धर्मकामौ जहाति ॥

meaning.en: One should always destroy the greedy by giving to them; the greedy never reach satisfaction with another's wealth. Everyone is greedy in enjoying the fruits of action, and one lacking wealth gives up dharma and desire.

verses.text:
धनं भोज्यं पुत्रदारं समृद्धिं
सर्वो लुब्धः प्रार्थयते परेषाम् ।
लुब्धे दोषाः संभवन्तीह सर्वे
तस्माद्राजा न प्रगृह्णीत लुब्धान् ॥

meaning.en: Wealth, food, sons, wives and prosperity: every greedy man longs for what belongs to others. All faults arise in the greedy, so a king should not take up greedy men.

verses.text:
संदर्शने सत्पुरुषं जघन्यमपि चोदयेत् ।
आरम्भान्द्विषतां प्राज्ञः सर्वानर्थांस्तु सूदयेत् ॥

meaning.en: In their presence the wise king should urge even the lowly toward the good, and destroy all the undertakings of his enemies.

verses.text:
धर्मान्वितेषु विज्ञातो मन्त्री गुप्तश्च पाण्डव ।
आप्तो राजन्कुलीनश्च पर्याप्तो राज्यसंग्रहे ॥

meaning.en: O Pandava, a minister should be known to be devoted to dharma, trusted, discreet, reliable, of good family, and capable of holding the kingdom together.

verses.text:
विधिप्रवृत्तान्नरदेवधर्मा-
नुक्तान्समासेन निबोध बुद्ध्या ।
इमान्विदध्याद्व्यनुसृत्य यो वै
राजा महीं पालयितुं स शक्तः ॥

meaning.en: Understand with your mind, as I state them briefly, these royal duties that proceed by rule. The king who follows and applies them is able to protect the earth.

verses.text:
अनीतिजं यद्यविधानजं सुखं
हठप्रणीतं विविधं प्रदृश्यते ।
न विद्यते तस्य गतिर्महीपते-
र्न विद्यते राष्ट्रजमुत्तमं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Happiness born of unsound policy, lack of method, or violent action may be seen in many forms, but that king has no way forward, and no supreme happiness arises from his realm.

verses.text:
धनैर्विशिष्टान्मतिशीलपूजिता-
न्गुणोपपन्नान्युधि दृष्टविक्रमान् ।
गुणेषु दृष्टानचिरादिहात्मवा-
न्सतोऽभिसंधाय निहन्ति शात्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: The self-possessed king, marking men eminent in wealth, honored for intellect and character, endowed with virtues and proven in battle, quickly destroys his enemies, relying on the good.

verses.text:
पश्येदुपायान्विविधैः क्रियापथै-
र्न चानुपायेन मतिं निवेशयेत् ।
श्रियं विशिष्टां विपुलं यशो धनं
न दोषदर्शी पुरुषः समश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: He should look for means through many courses of action and never set his mind on anything without a means. A man who looks only for faults never wins great prosperity, fame and wealth.

verses.text:
प्रीतिप्रवृत्तौ विनिवर्तने तथा
सुहृत्सु विज्ञाय निवृत्य चोभयोः ।
यदेव मित्रं गुरुभारमावहे-
त्तदेव सुस्निग्धमुदाहरेद्बुधः ॥

meaning.en: Among friends, the wise man should understand when affection begins and when it ends, and weigh both. The friend who bears a heavy burden he should call truly dear.

verses.text:
एतान्मयोक्तांस्तव राजधर्मा-
न्नृणां च गुप्तौ मतिमादधत्स्व ।
अवाप्स्यसे पुण्यफलं सुखेन
सर्वो हि लोकोत्तमधर्ममूलः ॥

meaning.en: I have told you these royal duties; set your mind on protecting men. You will gain the fruit of merit with ease, for every world rests on the supreme dharma.
